title: Creating a 1v1 Online FPS with a bot that can rocket jump, airshot and airstrafe: Scoville
author: M1ghtyMe
selftext:
Hi all,

For the past 2.5 months or so I have been working on a 1v1 first person shooter that you can play directly in your browser: [www.scoville.gg](http://www.scoville.gg)

You can play online vs friends via a simple duel link invite, or play vs the bot in the 'road to reaper' achievement journey. Start off vs the simple bot (Bell pepper) and work your way up to face the Carolina Reaper, the most difficult one.

It has been a fun journey to develop it so far, and I'm quite happy how the bot behaves right now: he can rocket jump, walljump, airstrafe, airshot and understands different scenario's quite well.

I wanted to build a bot that is difficult to beat not because he has 100% aimbot, but because he plays fair and is still better at movement such as rocket jumps and hitting airshots.

I keep the game in the browser so it is a super low entry playtest, which has it's limitations on the game engine but at the same time the game runs pretty well on lower end GPU's.

  
Especially open for feedback or ideas when it comes to the graphics... I'm currently very close to pushing in 8 different characters (1 for each bot tier) but it has been quite painful getting it done correctly and smoothing out all the small issues.

Happy to answer any q's
